epoch_goal: Turn the formal Hermes P1 implementation into an independently versioned, privacy-auditable, reproducibly installable alpha artifact without promoting any unverified adapter or behavioral claim.
goal: Deliver a harness-neutral Agent Image v0.1 protocol and toolchain with real Hermes, OpenClaw, DSH, and vHarness adapters; at least three P1 native restores; one Hermes-to-OpenClaw P2 migration; privacy-safe inspect, verify, diff, and redact; a restored trained-agent demonstration; and a third-party-extensible registry.

HC-001.rationale: The alpha preserves the existing privacy-safe inspect and redaction gates.

HC-002.rationale: The pinned Hermes native layer remains typed and explicitly adapter-specific.

HC-003.rationale: Hermes build and restore reports remain fully reconciled in the reproducible package.

HC-004.rationale: The alpha capability matrix limits claims to the evidence-backed Hermes P1 level.

HC-005.rationale: The alpha preserves development layers while the trained-agent proof remains the next epoch.

HC-006.rationale: Raw and referenced experience support remains planned for the trained-agent epoch.

HC-007.rationale: The same-model fresh-restore gate is explicitly unverified and scheduled next.

HC-008.rationale: Habitat categories remain outside the alpha runtime and unchanged in the horizon.

HC-009.rationale: The protocol distinction remains intact and will be exercised by the trained-agent proof.

HO-001.rationale: OCI remains a later transport option.

HO-002.rationale: The public adapter SDK and entry-point discovery remain later v0.1 modules.

HO-003.rationale: The user-approved implementation plan selects Apache-2.0 for the independent protocol repository.

HO-004.rationale: Context Body and consolidation remain future compatible directions.

HO-005.rationale: vHabitat and Team Image remain outside v0.1 without being rejected.

HO-006.rationale: Skill-preserving privacy stripping remains beyond alpha layer redaction.

HO-007.rationale: The alpha makes no skill-attractor claim; the next behavioral experiment may test it.

implementation_noninterference.review_note: The repository and packaging boundary derives from the approved horizon and release plan; only already formal Hermes P1 code is an implementation input.

interfaces: Standard wheel and sdist remain transport artifacts for the same formal CLI.
Capability documentation reports evidence status and never upgrades a planned adapter.
The standalone repository does not inherit Habitat or vHarness implementation history.

alpha-evidence.purpose: Own checksums, capability boundaries, release verdict, and existing Hermes P1 evidence linkage.

repository-boundary.purpose: Own the standalone Git history, Apache-2.0 license, and local privacy-safe identity.

reproducible-package.purpose: Own the lockfile, build artifacts, installed-package smoke, and cross-platform CI contract.

scope_authority.review_note: This alpha packages one proven adapter without rejecting any remaining adapter, behavioral, Habitat, team, or transport direction.
